comments.why: Shows a blower door tester revealing cut corners.
comments.text: The idea is that you don't rely on the process but measure the outcome with a device like this blower door tester. Builders are notorious for cutting corners with insulation and sealing air since it's not that obvious to the naked eye. The testing device reveals any cut corners. [VIDEO]
